newsitem.title: CANADA: Nuinsco drilling intercepts nickel, gold.
newsitem.headline: Nuinsco drilling intercepts nickel, gold.

text.p: Nuinsco Resources Ltd said on Monday it intersected "impressive" mineralization in a diamond drill hole at its Rainy River metals property in northwestern Ontario.

The company said that from 170.69 metres to 182.96 metres, the hole intersected a layered mafic-ultramafic intrusion with 2.93 metres of massive sulphide grading 3.31 percent nickel, 2.34 percent copper, 3.54 grams of platinum per tonne, 7.94 grams of palladium per tonne and 0.60 grams of gold per tonne.
Below the nickel intercept, from 186.13 metres to 214.62 metres, the weighted average grade of gold was 3.10 grams per tonne.
The hole was drilled to the north at 65 degrees about 50 metres east of another discovery hole, Nuinsco said.
